questions.question:
[경로: Polyketide(acetate-malonate) 경로]
다음 경로에서 ★로 표시한 물질의 이름은?

[[rxn:CC(=O)SC>>OC(=O)CC(=O)SC|CO₂, acetyl-CoA carboxylase]]
(★ → malonyl-CoA)

[[rxn:OC(=O)CC(=O)SC>>CC(=O)CC(=O)SC|acetyl-CoA, Claisen, −CO₂]]
(malonyl-CoA → acetoacetyl-CoA)
questions.explanation:
정답: acetyl-CoA
전체 경로:
acetyl-CoA →(CO₂, acetyl-CoA carboxylase)→ malonyl-CoA
malonyl-CoA →(acetyl-CoA, Claisen, −CO₂)→ acetoacetyl-CoA
acetoacetyl-CoA →(malonyl-CoA × 2)→ poly-β-keto ester
poly-β-keto ester →(aldol 고리화, 방향족화)→ orsellinic acid
참고: 같은 tetraketide가 Claisen 고리화되면 phloracetophenone(CC(=O)c1c(O)cc(O)cc1O).
그림:
[[img:pharmacognosy/local/pk-p04.png|PPT pk-p04]]
[[img:pharmacognosy/local/pk-p05.png|PPT pk-p05]]
